exact: labels, starts, lag, recipe, path identities
persisted bootstrap memberships, sign assignments and RNG bytes
computed_floats: First report binary64 equality; otherwise abs(new-old) <= 1e-12 + 1e-12*abs(old), with unchanged decisions and manuscript displays. No population statistic is recomputed by comparison.
lean_projection: Only an initial provenance/comment header; no mathematical body or internal comments are dropped.
process_projection: Explicit fields in comparison_policy.PROCESS_FIELDS are separately enumerated in difference JSONL; historical provenance is never substituted into fresh products.
paper_scope: The historical full profile does not acquire v25. Corrective-only paper macros require an independent corrective reproduction; they must not be declared reproduced by the historical profile. Documentary chronology is not a new estimator.
